package.title: Protect destination ownership during transfers and replacement rollback
scope: No-clobber Rename/Move/Copy/Keep Both when a competing writer wins the destination name.
Created directory cleanup must only remove output owned by this operation.
Replacement rollback must not remove or overwrite a destination another actor changed after staging.
acceptance: Deterministic competing-writer fixtures demonstrate the unsafe old behavior and verify the corrected behavior in Release.
Existing ordinary and cross-volume success/conflict/cancellation/recovery behavior remains qualified.
Failed operations leave competitor data intact and report honest conflict or verification failure.
Use qualified Common primitives where appropriate; preserve core/UI/filesystem authority.
Truthful docs state the scope of protection and remaining journal/session qualification gaps.
out_of_scope: New journal data format or complete live-session/durability redesign.
Unrelated UI features, broad rewrites, semantic/AI work.

evidence: OperationEngine delegates move semantics to one TransferOperationEngine implementation; same-volume moves verify the moved identity.
Copy completion verifies every recorded destination object, not only the root.
Cross-volume move quarantines the unchanged source, re-verifies the complete destination proof, then removes the source quarantine.
A fully copied, metadata-preserved and identity-verified destination is the truthful late-cancellation commit point.
Regular files use normal close semantics; unconditional per-file fsync was removed.
Replacement/restore staging records identity; rollback and cleanup quarantine and verify that staged object before restoring or removing it.
Release-effective deterministic tests cover complete child proof, staged-backup replacement and real /tmp-to-/dev/shm cross-volume move.

hard_findings.finding: Same-volume move accepts pathname presence rather than the captured source identity; cross-volume move deletes the source then compares the new copy's device/inode to the old source identity, so genuine cross-volume success returns VerificationFailure.
hard_findings.required: Verify same-volume destination against moved_identity. For cross-volume moves, preserve and verify the copied destination identity before source removal. Add true cross-volume and same-volume replacement-race Release tests.
hard_findings.resolution: One TransferOperationEngine move path verifies same-volume moved identity; cross-volume uses copied identities and source quarantine. Real /tmp→/dev/shm Release test passed.

hard_findings.finding: copy_exact records every output but verifies only owned.front(); a replaced child can be accepted while cross-volume move deletes the source.
hard_findings.required: Verify the complete owned output set, or provide equivalent full-copy proof, before success/source removal. Add a deterministic child-replacement Release test.
hard_findings.resolution: verify_all checks every recorded file/link/directory before success and again before source deletion; deterministic replaced-child proof test passed.

hard_findings.finding: Cancellation after copy_exact succeeds leaves both source and completed destination but returns Cancelled.
hard_findings.required: Safely clean the owned destination or make successful copy_exact completion the documented commit point and return truthful completion. Add a post-copy cancellation test.
hard_findings.resolution: Verified copy completion is the documented commit point; the post-copy Cancelled branch was removed, while in-copy cancellation and owned cleanup remain.

hard_findings.finding: Every copied regular file forces fsync, serializing large directory copies without complete directory durability.
hard_findings.required: Restore normal close semantics or implement a measured coherent durability policy; qualify large-tree behavior.
hard_findings.resolution: Unconditional per-file fsync removed; checked normal close semantics restored without claiming incomplete durability.

hard_findings.finding: Replacement and restore staging do not record the backup identity; rollback can restore and cleanup can remove_all a competitor replacement at the hidden backup pathname.
hard_findings.required: Record the staged object's identity and use identity-safe quarantine/verification before rollback or deletion. Add rollback and successful-cleanup replacement-race Release tests.
hard_findings.resolution: Staged identity is recorded; rollback and cleanup atomically quarantine and verify before restoring/removing. Deterministic backup replacement tests passed.

hard_findings.finding: After exclusive directory creation, a competing writer can swap the published directory before record(), causing the competitor inode to be recorded as owned and later mutated or removed.
hard_findings.required: Create and identify the directory privately, then publish atomically, or use an equivalent creation/identity mechanism that cannot derive ownership from a swappable public pathname. Add a deterministic Release race fixture.

hard_findings.finding: If destination is replaced between identity capture and staging rename, stage_destination moves the competitor to the hidden backup, detects mismatch, then returns without restoring it; the visible destination is left missing.
hard_findings.required: On identity mismatch, restore the renamed object to the original pathname with no-replace semantics and report/retain the exact quarantine path if restoration is unsafe. Add a deterministic staging-window fixture.

hard_findings.finding: If source identity changes between capture and same-volume rename, the replacement object is moved to destination; verification fails but the unrelated object is not restored.
hard_findings.required: Quarantine and verify the source before publishing it at destination, or restore the moved object safely on mismatch. Add a deterministic source-swap Release test.

hard_findings.finding: When the first post-copy verify_all fails, the source remains but unchanged owned destination outputs are left behind instead of being ownership-safely cleaned.
hard_findings.required: Run cleanup_owned for unchanged owned outputs while retaining the competing replacement and report any retained partial state honestly.

hard_findings.finding: Delegation removed source-versus-destination shape verification; source growth or new entries during copy can be omitted while recorded destination identities still verify, after which the newer source is deleted.
hard_findings.required: After quarantining the source into a stable pathname, compare supported source content/shape with the destination before source deletion. Add mutation-during-copy Release coverage.

hard_findings.finding: If remove_all(source_quarantine) fails, remaining source content stays hidden under an internal cleanup name while the error implies the original path remains available.
hard_findings.required: Attempt no-replace restoration of any remaining quarantine to source before returning; if unsafe, report the exact retained path. Add partial deletion failure evidence.

hard_findings.finding: The documented test suite fails when /dev/shm is unavailable, unwritable or on the same device as the temporary directory.
hard_findings.required: Treat absence of two writable distinct filesystems as a skipped qualification or explicitly provision the second mount; retain real cross-volume evidence in CI.
